name: Safi of Persia
role: Safavid Shah of Iran from 1629 to 1642
contribution: The sixth shah of Safavid Iran, ruling from 1629 to 1642.

checks.lead: Sam Mirza (Persian: سام میرزا; 1611 – 12 May 1642), known by his regnal name of Shah Safi (Persian: شاه صفی), was the sixth shah of Safavid Iran, ruling from 1629 to 1642. Abbas the Great was succeeded by his grandson, Safi. A reclusive and passive character, Safi was unable to fill the power vacuum which his grandfather had left behind. His officials undermined his authority and revolts constantly broke out across the realm. The continuing war with the Ottoman Empire, started with initial success during Abbas the Great's reign, but ended with the defeat of Iran and the Treaty of Zuhab, which returned much of Iran's conquests in Mesopotamia to the Ottomans.
